lamblanterns.configuration.horizontalOff: 0.0 = centred, positive = right hip (1.0 = default), negative = left hip (-1.0). Larger magnitudes push it further off the side.
lamblanterns.configuration.verticalOffse: Higher = raise the lantern (towards the chest), lower = drop it (towards the belt/hip). Dial to taste.
lamblanterns.configuration.depthOffset.t: Higher = move towards the front of the body, lower = towards the back. Dial to taste.
